description: Manage snapshots of supported registered state sources: capture, preview, restore, capture_baseline, delete or rename. Preview affected items before restoring. Live mode replaces supported state in place; reload mode restores supported persisted storage and requests a JS reload. Baselines clear providers that support clearing and request a reload; they do not reset backend state or reproduce a complete reinstall. restoreRoute:true requests the captured route when available. Inspect per-source applied/skipped results and reload outcomes.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

excludeKeys.description: Restore only: item keys to LEAVE UNTOUCHED, as "sourceId::itemKey" (itemKey = the key shown by the preview action, e.g. "query::[\"pokemon\"]" or "storage::async:@cart").

id.description: Snapshot id (required for restore/delete/rename; from get_time_machine).

restoreRoute.description: Restore only: also navigate back to the route the snapshot was captured on (shown as `route` by get_time_machine). With mode 'reload' the navigation happens automatically on the next boot. Default false — state is restored but the app stays on the current screen.

sourceIds.description: Capture/restore only these source ids (default all).

name: time_machine_action
